summary: #115037 remains a real, narrow Claude CLI live-session recovery bug on main aa2a5c96f69a1be639c602649d4aa2e4de8da0a8. After the exact resumed synthetic placeholder and its bounded continuation grace expire, the live-session owner currently resolves an empty output. The generic CLI runner then throws an unmarked empty_response, bypassing its existing same-model fresh-session recovery gate and allowing the outer model-fallback loop to select a configured fallback model. The narrow repair is to make that specific terminal lifecycle outcome reject as the already-supported retryable empty-response code, so the runner clears the stale binding and retries once on the originally selected model with a fresh CLI process.
